meta.name: azure-kubernetes
meta.description: Plan, create, and configure production-ready Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters. Covers Day-0 checklist, SKU selection (Automatic vs Standard), networking options (private API server, Azure CNI Overlay, egress configuration), security, and operations (autoscaling, upgrade strategy, cost analysis). WHEN: create AKS environment, provision AKS, enable AKS observability, design AKS networking, choose AKS SKU, secure AKS, optimize AKS, AKS spot nodes, AKS cluster-autoscaler, rightsize AKS pod, pod rightsizing, over-provisioned AKS pod, pod resource requests and limits, Vertical Pod Autoscaler, VPA recommendations.

howto.what: 该技能让Claude成为AKS集群规划助手，根据用户需求生成推荐配置，区分Day-0（网络、API服务器）和Day-1决策，涵盖SKU选择、网络、安全、监控、升级、成本等。
howto.when: 当用户要创建新AKS集群、规划生产配置、设计网络、设置安全或监控、比较AKS Automatic与Standard SKU、获取Day-0检查清单时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划一个生产级AKS集群，使用Azure CNI Overlay网络。
say.note: Claude会生成推荐配置，包括网络、SKU、安全等。

say.text: AKS Automatic和Standard SKU有什么区别？
say.note: Claude会解释两者差异并推荐适合你的类型。

say.text: 我需要一份AKS集群的Day-0决策清单。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude becomes an AKS cluster planning assistant. It generates recommended configurations based on user requirements, distinguishing Day-0 (networking, API server) from Day-1 decisions, covering SKU selection, networking, security, observability, upgrades, and cost.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to create a new AKS cluster, plan production configuration, design networking, set up security or observability, compare AKS Automatic vs Standard SKU, or get a Day-0 checklist.

say_en.text: Plan a production AKS cluster with Azure CNI Overlay.
What are the differences between AKS Automatic and Standard?
